updates.prompt: An EIGRP router compares eligible internal paths for exactly the same prefix within one EIGRP domain, using default settings. Which listed routing value is used to prefer the best path?
updates.explanation:
C，metric。EIGRP使用自身的复合路径度量选择可用successor，DUAL同时负责保持无环；并非仅取任意邻居报告的最小数而忽略可行性。经典默认K1=K3=1、其余为0，带宽项取路径瓶颈、延迟项累加：
```text
BW = 10^7 / minimum_path_bandwidth_in_kbps
DLY = sum_of_outgoing_interface_delays_in_microseconds / 10
classic_metric = 256 * (BW + DLY)
```
FD用于可行性判断，是自上次Active到Passive后记录的最低距离，不总等于当前某条路径metric。A/AS_PATH是BGP属性；B/AD用于相同完整前缀的来源入表竞争，本题内部默认AD相同，不能区分路径，外部EIGRP/自定义AD则另当别论；D/cost是泛称，常用于OSPF，但不是某协议独占词，本题准确选EIGRP metric。宽度量的缩放还需按实现区分。

updates.prompt: What is the primary purpose of using a First Hop Redundancy Protocol on an IPv4 LAN subnet?

options.label: A
options.text: provides a redundant virtual default gateway that another eligible router can take over when the active gateway fails

options.label: B
options.text: sends the default route to the hosts on a network

options.label: D
options.text: filters traffic based on destination IP addressing
